title: 低床台はかり
description: 荷さばき場・業務用室内で箱や台車の計量位置を示す低床台はかり。金属計量台、前後の短い進入板、下面の補強と四つの荷重検出部外形、調整足、接続された支柱式表示器と実ケーブルを造形。表示は無表示で、荷物・台車は含みません。質量計算、校正精度、耐荷重や機能認証は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.989 × 1.213 × 1.224 m、6,416三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A low platform scale marking a weighing position for parcels or carts in dispatch and service rooms. It has a metal deck, short front/rear approach plates, underside braces and four load-cell exteriors, adjusting-looking feet, attached post indicator and real cable geometry. The indicator is blank; cargo and carts are absent. Mass calculation, calibrated accuracy, load ratings and functional certification are not provided. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.989 × 1.213 × 1.224 m; 6,416 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
